thread:
Tilly (Sales): Heads up — Velocare reported 30% throughput drop on their dedicated pool after last week's routing change. They say p95 shot from 220ms -> 380ms.
Matt (Eng): Hmm, which route/model? any customer-specific quant or batch config?
Tilly (Sales): Route: /v1/generate - model=redwood-medium-quant - dedicated pool 'velocare-dedicated'
Maria (Support): They've got steady QPS ~120, spikes to 250 during batch windows. Support logs show increased queueing and a lot of 'evicted from batch' warnings.
Jun (SRE): Can you paste the last 1min of RT logs? Also need the trace IDs.
Tilly (Sales): attaching snippet from support ticket:
```
[2026-03-15T14:02:21Z] route=/v1/generate model=redwood-medium-quant qps=230 p95=380ms evicted_batches=42
[2026-03-15T14:02:22Z] task_enqueue_ms=40 processing_ms=320 cache_hit=false
```
Matt (Eng): That processing_ms is high for quant path. Could be kernel selection fallback or heavy KV cache thrashing.
Alex (Product): Customer asks for a mitigation path + roadmap ask. They want (1) short-term: rollback routing change or pin to non-quant variant; (2) long-term: batching/config suggestion in Redwood Optimize + SLA guarantee. Need scope/priority.
Maria (Support): Customer is paying enterprise reserved capacity + SLA. This is P1 for them.
Matt (Eng): Short-term options: 1) route them to redwood-medium (non-quant) 2) force smaller batch sizes 3) enable aggressive prefix caching. Low-risk is routing to non-quant.
Jun (SRE): We can add a temporary routing rule for that dedicated pool — low effort. I can push a canary in 10m.
Tilly (Sales): Customer wants a timeline before EOD. Please confirm plan.
Alex (Product): OK — product decision: tactical mitigation (route -> non-quant) now; follow-up: add 'dedicated pool perf checklist' to backlog and prioritize in next planning cycle. Who owns the backlog ticket?
Matt (Eng): I'll create an ENG ticket with acceptance criteria: repro steps, perf delta >=20% on medium load, rollback plan, test coverage for quant kernel selection. Assign to eng-runtime.
Maria (Support): I'll send customer the temporary routing ETA and collect traces.
Jun (SRE): I'll implement routing rule and monitor p95. Post changes I'll drop a quick dashboard snapshot.
SupportBot: Deployment job started by Jun — job_id=deploy-7882 — ETA ~8m :rocket:
Tilly (Sales): :thumbsup: thanks team. Please @me in the ticket when created.
Alex (Product): Add acceptance for 'customer-facing mitigation' and 'roadmap item for Optimize + per-customer quant guidance'. Mark P0 for SLA customers. :eyes:
Matt (Eng): ticket: RDW-4312 created — link: https://redwood.atlassian/browse/RDW-4312 — assigning eng-runtime. Added logs + snippet.
Tilly (Sales): Shared link with Velocare. They acknowledged. Closing loop once metrics look good.
Jun (SRE): p95 dropped to 210ms after routing change — monitoring looks stable. Will keep it open for 24h.
Tilly (Sales): Great. If it holds, product can capture as a case study for Dedicated performance playbook.
Alex (Product): Agreed. We'll scope Optimize recommendations as a follow-up epic. :shipit:
